# Proverbs 5 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 5:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | My-son, to-my-wisdom attend, to-my-understanding incline your-ear, |
| LOGOS | My son, be attentive to my wisdom; incline your ear to my understanding, |
| PNEUMA | My child, pay close attention to my wisdom. Really listen to my understanding, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| LOGOS | That you may keep discretion, and your lips may guard knowledge. |
| PNEUMA | So that you'll know how to make good choices, and your words will show that you know what's important. |
